description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Sands Cottage Carriage” in the heart of Rosemary Beach. This newly renovated gem comfortably sleeps 3 and features a full kitchen, large balcony with scenic views, and access to 4 community pools. A 1-minute walk to Cabana Pool and located close to boutiques and dining. Includes 2 bikes to explore the charming 30A area. Perfect for a relaxing couple or small family getaway! Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***1-Minute Walk to the Cabana PoolAccess to All 4 Rosemary Beach Resort PoolsLarge Balcony with Serene Views Off the Living RoomNewly Renovated with Granite Countertops and Beach-Chic DécorIncludes 2 Bikes - Perfect for Exploring 30A and Quick Rides to the BeachShort Walk to Fitness Center and Tennis CourtsClose to Boutique Shopping and Amazing DiningOutdoor Grilling Area for Relaxed EveningsSleeping for 3 with a Twin Bed Nook and a King Bed BedroomEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Loved the updated decor and the comfy beds! The Cabana Pool being so close was a huge bonus for us after the beach." – Mindi H.⭐"Beautiful, clean Carriage House with easy access to beaches, pools, shops, and restaurants. The bikes were super convenient for a fun and scenic ride!" – Beth W.⭐"The location was perfect, and the house was gorgeous. Everything we needed for a relaxing stay!" – Shannon K.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into your beachside retreat featuring an open-concept design perfect for unwinding after a day in the sun. Relax on the plush sofa while indulging in your favorite show, or step onto the balcony and enjoy the serene views with your morning coffee or evening wine.Spacious living room with a smart TV, and stylish furnishingsLarge balcony perfect for relaxing and enjoy ocean breezeFull-size washer and dryer for added convenience*** KITCHEN & DINING ***This updated kitchen is a dream for anyone who loves to cook or share meals with loved ones. Outfitted with stainless steel appliances and seating for four at the kitchen island, every detail has been thoughtfully designed for your culinary convenience.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesKitchen island seating for 4Includes oven, microwave, dishwasher & full-sized fridge*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE AREA ***Enjoy the grill area in the charming private courtyard, then take a relaxing bike ride to the nearby Cabana Pool. Whether you’re grilling with family or soaking in the sun, the outdoor spaces make every moment magical.Outdoor grilling area for family barbecues2 cruiser bikes included for scenic 30A trailsPrivate courtyard perfect for relaxation*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Find restful luxury in every corner of this newly renovated carriage house. The king-sized primary loft provides a chic and cozy retreat, while the built-in twin bed with its own privacy door ensures everyone has their own relaxing space.2nd Floor:Twin Bed with private sliding door and its own TV in a cozy nookFull bathroom with dual vanities and a spacious walk-in shower3rd Floor Loft:Primary King Suite with king-sized bed, flat-screen TV and cozy reading chairs*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the vibrant heart of Rosemary Beach, this carriage house puts everything at your fingertips. Grab your morning coffee at Amavida Coffee, enjoy locally-loved dining spots like La Crema and Edwards Dining, or relax on the sugar-white sands just a short walk away.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountains1 Minute Walk to Cabana Pool4 Minute Walk to the Heated Sky Pool and Fitness Center5 Minute Walk to Tennis Courts4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
